name: MiniMax H3 音频生成
code:
import asyncio
import aiohttp

async def generate(ctx, api):
    api_key = api.get("api_key") or ""
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("MiniMax H3 音频生成缺少 API Key，请在 Provider 配置中填入 MiniMax API Key")
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    url = "https://api.minimax.chat/v1/t2a_v2"
    body = {
        "model": ctx.get("model", "speech-01-turbo"),
        "text": ctx.get("text", ""),
        "voice_id": ctx.get("voice_id", "male-qn-qingse"),
        "speed": float(ctx.get("speed", 1.0)),
        "vol": float(ctx.get("vol", 1.0)),
        "pitch": int(ctx.get("pitch", 0)),
        "emotion": ctx.get("emotion", "neutral"),
    }
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.post(url, json=body, headers=headers) as resp:
            if resp.status != 200:
                raise RuntimeError(f"MiniMax TTS HTTP {resp.status}: {await resp.text()}")
            data = await resp.json()
        base = data.get("base_resp", {})
        if base.get("status_code", 0) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"MiniMax TTS 失败: {base}")
        audio_b64 = data.get("audio")
        if not audio_b64:
            raise RuntimeError("MiniMax TTS 未返回音频数据")
        audio_type = data.get("audio_type", "wav")
        return {"audio_url": f"data:audio/{audio_type};base64,{audio_b64}"}
